mīna: [Mi+naka] (pu) CL=7 [Mara+īna. Mi hi sāyaṃ,naka,moga,7.105.mara pāṇacāge, īno, ra lopo. Dhāna,ṭī. 671-2.suci.] Fish.
mīyati: [Mā+ya+te] (kri) CL=7 (1) It is created. (2) It is compared.
mīyetha: [Mara+eyya]  CL=9 You (pl) would die. See - Marati.
mīḷha: [Miḷā+la.mi] (na) CL=7 [Secane,lovaṇṇavipariyāyo,ḷattañca. Dhāna,ṭī.275. Mīla+ha. Mīlissa ḷho. Nimilantānena akkhīnītimīḷha=gūthaṃ. Moga,7.223.] Excrement. See also - Miḷhasukha, mīḷhasukha.
mīḷhakā: [Mīḷha+ka+ā] (thī) CL=7 Insects that eat excrement. Excrement beetle.
mīḷhalitta: [Mīḷha+litta] (ti) CL=7 Smeared with excrement. Dirt with excrement.
mīḷhamakkhita: [Mīḷha+makkhita] (ti) CL=7 Smeared with excrement. Dirt with excrement.
mīḷhasukha: [Mīḷha+sukha] (na) CL=7 Filthy pleasure. The pleasure that is dependent on the filth.
